Package com.saicone.gama.util

Interface LabeledList<L,E>

Type Parameters:
L - the type of labels in this list
E - the type of elements in this list
All Superinterfaces:
Collection<E>, Iterable<E>, List<E>, SequencedCollection<E>
All Known Implementing Classes:
ArrayLabeledList, LinkedLabeledList
public interface LabeledList<L,E> extends List<E>
An extension of the List interface that associates a label for each element.
Unlike List, this interface will fail with an UnsupportedOperationException when using most of the methods that modify the list without specifying a label.
